subject: Culture
title: Seed Banks of the World
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Seed Banks of the World.

hook.text: Deep inside an Arctic mountain, a vault holds seeds from every nation. It's the doomsday backup.

buildup.text: The Svalbard Global Seed Vault stores over a million seed samples. It guards crop diversity against disaster.

discovery.text: Syria's seed bank was destroyed in war. Svalbard had the backup. Seeds came home to restart farming.

twist.text: 97% of vegetable varieties from 1900 are now extinct. We lost more food diversity than we saved.

climax.text: Seed banks aren't just science. They're cultural memory, preserving what entire civilizations ate.

punchline.text: A frozen seed is a civilization's insurance policy.

quiz.question: Where is the Svalbard Global Seed Vault located?
